verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is a local AI assistant with agents, so a command-execution and file-editing surface is a fair axis for it. However, no evidence documents a built-in ability to run shell commands or edit local files. Custom Agent Skills and the developer guide are building blocks a developer could use to construct such a capability, and MCP compatibility only means plugging in third-party tools. Neither counts as the product's own exec surface.
